content.value_statement: Azure messaging failures are hard to isolate across SDK, service health, and configuration. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Event Hubs and Service Bus troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK failure patterns from user-provided errors.
Guides checks for Azure resource health and namespace status.
Recommends Microsoft Learn documentation searches for specific AMQP or SDK errors.
Helps review connection strings, entity names, consumer groups, retry settings, prefetch, and batch size.
Covers lock renewal, session lock, dead letter, checkpoint, duplicate event, and offset reset scenarios.
limitations: Requires user-provided error details or configured Azure MCP tool access.
Does not include the detailed troubleshooting guides referenced in another skill.
Does not automatically change Azure resources or SDK code.
Focuses on Azure Event Hubs and Azure Service Bus only.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Production Disconnects
use_cases.description: Trace idle timeouts, AMQP link detach errors, and slow reconnect behavior for Event Hubs or Service Bus workloads.

use_cases.title: Resolve Lock Failures
use_cases.description: Investigate message lock lost, session lock expired, and lock renewal failures during queue or subscription processing.

use_cases.title: Review SDK Configuration
use_cases.description: Check retry policy, prefetch, batch size, consumer group, and checkpoint settings before changing application behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Basic Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose this Azure Service Bus SDK error: [paste error]. Ask for any missing SDK, version, namespace, and entity details.

prompt_templates.title: Review Event Hubs Consumption
prompt_templates.prompt: An Event Hubs consumer stopped receiving events after a disconnect. Guide me through health, consumer group, checkpoint, and retry checks.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Lock Renewal
prompt_templates.prompt: My Service Bus processor reports message lock lost during batch handling. Help identify configuration, handler timing, and lock renewal causes.

prompt_templates.title: Correlate Logs and Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this recurring Azure Messaging incident using resource health, diagnostic logs, exact SDK errors, and current retry, prefetch, and batch settings.

output_examples.input: A Java Service Bus processor reports message lock lost during batch handling.
output_examples.output: Likely causes include long processing time, high batch size, or failed lock renewal. Check handler duration, lock duration, renewal settings, and dead-letter impact.

output_examples.input: An Event Hubs consumer stopped receiving after a disconnect.
output_examples.output: Check resource health, consumer group, checkpoint offset, reconnect logs, and SDK retry settings. Search Microsoft Learn for the exact AMQP detach error.

output_examples.input: A user reports send timeouts but has not shared environment details.
output_examples.output: Request SDK language, package version, namespace region, connection mode, entity name, and exact timeout text before recommending changes.

best_practices: Start with service health and exact SDK error text before changing configuration.
Collect SDK language, version, namespace, entity name, and consumer group details.
Cite Microsoft Learn guidance when recommending retry, lock, or checkpoint changes.
anti_patterns: Do not reset checkpoints before confirming duplicate delivery impact.
Do not increase batch size when messages already exceed lock duration.
Do not expose connection strings or tokens in prompts, logs, or screenshots.

faq.question: What services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Azure Event Hubs and Azure Service Bus SDK troubleshooting.

faq.question: Does this skill change Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It guides diagnosis and recommendations, but it does not modify resources or application code.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with message lock lost errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers message locks, session locks, lock renewal, and batch processing timeouts.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the SDK language, package version, namespace, entity name, exact error, and recent behavior changes.

faq.question: Should I paste secrets into prompts?
faq.answer: No. Redact connection strings, keys, tokens, and customer data before sharing troubleshooting details.
